items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012

ctx.x: So that was fortunate working at The Colonial. Because everyone worked there, all the greats, and I can’t even remember — Artie Shaw came. Goodman didn’t come while I was there but oh, I can’t remember, Erroll Garner, everybody.
So you got to know them as personalities as well as musicians.
